name: Moonbots
blurb: Send your bots to work, build a rocket and fly to the Moon!

source.notes: Wordmark card-wordmark.png is the home-screen title rendered as-is: Press Start 2P, MOON #d9541e + BOTS #1d8b7e, 0 5px 0 #2b1d14 shadow. Background is the game's Moon City level pattern (the small dots from pat-craters on #9a9fb0, js/art.js; big crater rings left out), kept plain so the title reads. Ink #2b1d14 blurb.
